rationale: The base station auto-updated to firmware 4.5, which dropped protocol v2 support, while the Hallway Motion sensor (SEN-M1) was still on firmware 1.1 speaking protocol v2, producing E-305 and "connected_no_events". check_firmware_compat confirmed an OTA path to 1.4 (protocol v3), and after the frontline-triggered OTA completed to 1.4 the sensor resumed sending alerts. This is a standard L1 firmware-mismatch fix, now resolved.

repair_steps: Confirm the Hallway Motion sensor firmware is now 1.4 and status is online with events.
Verify no E-305 errors remain in base station logs.
Close the case as resolved with root cause PERIPHERAL_FW_OUTDATED (L1).

If you notice any further issues, feel free to reach out. Thank you for your patience!

results.text: The peripheral firmware speaks a radio protocol the base station no longer supports, or vice versa. Frontline action: trigger OTA upgrade of the peripheral. If OTA is not available for the device or fails twice, escalate to FAE as protocol conflict.

Peripheral firmware is upgraded over the air (OTA) from the base station. Requirements: device within normal signal range, battery above 30 percent. CAM-S1 1.x upgrades to 2.1 (protocol v3). SEN-D1 1.0 upgrades to 1.3, SEN-M1 1.1 upgrades to 1.4. CAM-I2 hardware revision A with firmware 1.2 cannot be upgraded to protocol v3.
